_note: v2.8 plan 69 K8 (no-model lane). Host fact: Recast's accept mutates chat[n].mes without touching swipes, calls updateMessageBlock, emits MESSAGE_EDITED and saves (recast R/index.js:1086-1097, docs/plans/v2.8/extension-research-2026-10-14/recast.md P2). TurnBridge routes an edit of the newest reply through the edit re-read seam (spikes/editReread.ts) after rollbackOnEnter. Expected outcome: the delayed rewrite (after the reply's boundary) is re-read once, the story steps back from the reply at most once, and the state then equals a replay of the rewritten text (here: the rewritten reply supports no lamp, so lit_lamp is gone and took_key stays). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k8-delayed-rewrite.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); if (s.blackboard.values.lit_lamp !== true) throw new Error('setup: lit_lamp did not land from the reply'); const markRt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ms = markRt.getEngineState(); globalThis.__k8 = { boundary: ms.boundary, last: ms.lastMessageId, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null }; return globalThis.__k8;

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; ctx.chat[id].mes = 'Arin leaves the oil lamp dark and waits.'; ctx.updateMessageBlock(id, ctx.chat[id]); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); await ctx.saveChat(); return { id };

const out = (() => { const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s = rt.getEngineState(); return { boundary: s.boundary, last: s.lastMessageId, values: s.blackboard.values, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null, mark: globalThis.__k8 }; })(); const k = globalThis.__k8; const rerereads = out.recommits === null || k.recommits === null ? null : out.recommits - k.recommits; if (out.values.lit_lamp === true) throw new Error('lit_lamp, read from the reply before its rewrite, survived'); if (out.values.took_key !== true) throw new Error('took_key, read before the reply, was lost'); if (rerereads !== null && rerereads !== 1) throw new Error('expected one re-read of the rewritten reply, got ' + rerereads); return { ...out, rereads: rerereads };
